And when we look at the year-on-year performance, we were down 70 basis points on a year-on-year basis. And that was driven by a different mix and foreign exchange. Great. Thank you. Thank you. Great. Thank you, Mike.

claims.claim: Management said product gross margin fell 70 basis points year over year, citing a different mix and foreign exchange.

structured_claims.overall_summary: Apple reported March-quarter revenue of $95.4 billion, up 5% year over year, and diluted EPS of $1.65, up 8% to a March-quarter record. Products gross margin was 35.9%, down 340 basis points sequentially. Management said China was down 2%, or roughly flat excluding foreign-exchange headwinds.
